strings.170: Spread your wings and take flight. Use normal flight controls to ascend and descend. Flight lasts indefinitely outside combat and grants up to 15 total seconds in combat per activation. Activating Hover from the ground while in combat grants immunity to Stun effects for 3 seconds. A successful stun ends Hover. When Hover ends, descend safely to the ground and begin a 2-minute cooldown. Activate again to land.

strings.170: Draw your weapon and leap to an enemy within 25 yards, dealing Holy impact damage and slowing nearby enemies by 30% for 3 seconds. While hovering, dive instead for 20% more impact damage; Hover ends after the dive. Interrupted dives end Hover safely, and its cooldown starts on landing. The impact creates a 5-yard Consecration for 3 seconds, dealing Holy damage each second. Damage scales with your higher attack power or spell power. 2-minute cooldown.
